question: Who are identified as the independent impellers of the lineage across the four ages?
premises: They are impellers of the family or lineage
inference: The independent impellers of the lineage are identified in relation to the four ages.
uncertainties: The precise syntactic relation of caturyuga iti to the rest of the verse is compressed.
plain_english: O Lord of gods, thus are the independent impellers of the lineage, called the Four Ages.
